title: I pushed an update to my tower-defense base-building train-automation web game: 1) idiot-proof tutorial update with giant arrows, 2) enemy rebalance, 3) performance improvements, 4) new tools like being able to clear/terraform land
author: BrennusSokol
selftext:
Play it here:

https://aaronshaver.github.io/Hylaax-Planetary-Rail-Defense/

(if you've played before, be sure to do a hard cache refresh with CTRL-SHIFT-R or CMD-SHIFT-R)

Text talking about AI game dev: yesterday Codex/Open AI seemed really slow. And the model over-thought a relatively simple change, taking 30 minutes when it shouldn't have taken that long. I do still catch these models, even relatively "smart" ones like GPT-5.6 Sol High coming up with implementations that I as a human know are over-complicated. But it's still a powerful tool. I love how I can trivially refactor things and clean up things and hit all my wishlist items. It can be addicting, though. Need to force myself to take breaks.
